notes.title: สมุดจากโลกของยมทูต
notes.text: สมุดกระดาษว่างที่แตะเขียน ย้าย และปรับขนาดได้ ใช้เหนือ chatbar พร้อมใบหน้าจากโรล ชื่อจริงและอายุขัยจากดวงตา กติกาไทย/อังกฤษ 71 หน้า และกฎปลอมที่ไม่เปลี่ยนอำนาจจริง

notes.title: Notebook owners and eye origins
notes.text: Notebook IDs remain stable. Original Shinigami, current Shinigami owner, attendant, human rights owner and physical holder are separate. Player and NPC eyes may be innate, granted, roleplay-established or paid by a bargain. Non-bargain eyes require no notebook and no half-life payment. NPC knowledge never becomes player knowledge automatically.

notes.title: Character settings and immediate eye identity
notes.text: Workshop preferences follow the character across chats. Granted eye abilities apply immediately; explicit visible true names repair role-labelled NPC dossiers. Notebook ownership, paid bargains, deaths and journals remain local to their chat and Branch.

notes.title: Human lifespan display
notes.text: Choose remaining human time, the original story-day deadline, or both in Workshop settings. Display conversions follow the story clock, with 365 days per year; stored lifespans and eye bargains retain their original values.

notes.title: Name language and true-name display
notes.text: Choose original, Thai or English character names separately from interface language. An optional true-name display reveals authored labels without granting eyes, lifespans or character knowledge. Authored full-name translations refer to the same NPC; genuine aliases stay ineffective inscriptions.
